description: Zentrale KidMotion Bildwelt. Erst drei Flow-kompatible Cover, dann eine Nutzerwahl. Das gewaehlte Cover wird Szene 01 und die visuelle Referenz. Danach werden alle weiteren Bilder intern in 5er-Bloecken automatisch bis Szene 28 erzeugt, ohne weitere Rueckfragen. Google Flow erzeugt alle sichtbaren Texte; Remotion zeichnet nur den Countdown-Timer.
rules: 16:9 landscape, premium stylized 3D family-friendly animation look
exactly one recurring original KidMotion mascot character per episode
cover prompts use a clearly fictional stylized mascot character and stay non-photorealistic
cover prompts must NOT specify an exact age number, skin tone, body type, body measurements or detailed minor physical profile
cover prompts describe only broad safe visual traits such as outfit colors, hairstyle category, friendly expression, simple pose and environment
generate exactly three cover candidates first and wait only for the user's one-time cover choice
the selected cover is renamed Szene 01.png and becomes the primary identity/outfit/world/color reference
delete the two rejected cover candidates immediately after selection
after cover selection use Szene 01 itself for identity continuity instead of repeating detailed demographic or body descriptions in later prompts
after cover selection generate later scenes in ordered internal batches of maximum five images
batch 1 is Szene 02-06, batch 2 Szene 07-11, batch 3 Szene 12-16, batch 4 Szene 17-21, batch 5 Szene 22-26, final batch Szene 27-28
after cover selection automatically continue from one image batch to the next without asking the user again
do not pause to show or request approval between batches
deliver the completed image folder only after all required scenes have been generated and named
Szene 01 remains the primary character/outfit/world reference in every batch
Szene 05 becomes the secondary exercise title/instruction UI reference after batch 1
all remaining final images are named Szene 02.png through Szene 28.png and stored in the same flat image folder
12 exercise scenes must have obviously different silhouettes, body levels and directions; avoid a sequence dominated by squat/lunge/balance variants
the same gym/adventure world may use different zones and modest camera-angle changes to avoid repetitive frames while keeping continuity
dedicated GET READY scenes are Szene 06,08,10,12,14,16,18,20,22,24,26
every GET READY scene shows a neutral ready stance, not the next exercise pose, and contains GET READY plus NEXT: exercise title
ALL visible text except the changing countdown number is generated directly by Google Flow inside the source image
Szene 02 contains complete Intro text; Szene 03 Safety; Szene 04 LET'S BEGIN!
Szene 28 contains GREAT JOB! and WORKOUT COMPLETE
top-left 230x230 px remains clear on exercise and GET READY images for the Remotion timer
there is no Remotion progress bar and no Remotion REST/NEXT text
forbidden: exact numeric age in a cover prompt
detailed minor body description in a cover prompt
photorealistic child imagery in a cover prompt
generating Szene 02 or later before explicit user cover selection
keeping rejected cover candidates after selection
generating more than five later scenes in one internal batch
asking the user to continue between image batches
stopping after a normal image batch before the full scene set is complete
cropped hands, feet or important joints
reusing the next 20-second exercise image during the 5-second transition
more than two neighboring exercises with near-identical squat/lunge/balance silhouettes
